Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): 夜風が、ただならぬ予感を運んでくる。PAで休息を取ろうとしても、どこか落ち着かない気分だった。
Text (EN): The night wind carried an ominous feeling. Even trying to rest at the parking area, I couldn't shake this uneasy mood.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): やがて――PAに真新しいR35が入って来た。初めて見るマシンだが、貼られているエンブレムには見覚えがある。
Text (EN): Just then, a brand-new R35 rolled into the parking area. I'd never seen this machine before, but the emblem on it looked familiar.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリスだ。無事だったのか――。
Text (EN): 【ETERNAL POLARIS】. So she was okay...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): R35から降りてきたのは、確かに彼女だった。お互い無言のまま、しばし見つめ合う。彼女の瞳の中に、以前とは比べ物にならないほど強い闘志が煌いているのが見えた。
Text (EN): The one who stepped out of the R35 was definitely her. We locked eyes in silence for a moment. In her gaze, I could see a fighting spirit burning with radiance beyond compare.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): …………久しぶり。
Text (EN): ...It's been a while.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): うん……クルマ、替えたの。
Text (EN): Yeah... I got a new ride.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): 大丈夫。キミを貶めた人たちは――みんな倒した。
Text (EN): It's okay. The people who disgraced you―I beat them all.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't
Text (JP): 湾岸線……待ってる。今までの私とは……違うから……。
Text (EN): I'll be waiting... On the Bayshore Line. I'm not... The same person I used to be...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Things That Change, Things That Don't

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): バトルはひとまず決着したが、一徹ストレートとマネードリームの乱入によって、心にしこりが残る結末となった。
Text (EN): The battle had reached its conclusion, but the intrusion by 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 and 【MONEY DREAM】 left a bitter taste that lingered in everyone's mouths.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリスの走りからも、かすかな不安が伝わってくる。自分たちはそれぞれの想いを抱えながら、4台で連れ立ってPAに戻る。
Text (EN): Even 【ETERNAL POLARIS】's driving betrayed traces of unease. Each grappling with their own thoughts, the four cars headed back to the parking area together.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 口火を切ったのは久遠のポラリスだった。
Text (EN): 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 was the first to break the silence.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): ……一徹ストレート。マネードリームも。……どうして……？
Text (EN): ...【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】. 【MONEY DREAM】 too. ...Why...?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): バトルに割り込んじまって、すまねぇ。でも、こいつは……！こいつがお前を危険な目に遭わせたんだろ！？
Text (EN): Sorry for butting into your battle, but this guy...! He's the one who put you in danger, right!?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 1人で挑むのは危険だわ。私たちを頼って！
Text (EN): Taking him on alone is too dangerous. You should rely on us!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): だって――、私たち、仲間でしょ！
Text (EN): After all, we're a team, aren't we?!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): …………2人とも……。ありがとう。
Text (EN): Both of you... Thank you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): でも……私に危険走行を仕掛けたのは、バッドボンバー。観光客じゃない。
Text (EN): But... The one who attacked me was 【BAD BOMBER】. Not 【{bad_name}】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): ……な、なにっ。バッドボンバーといやあ、俺に情報をタレこんだ奴じゃねェか。
Text (EN): ...Wh-What? 【BAD BOMBER】? That's the bastard who fed me that info!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): てェことは……くそっ、初めから全部、奴が仕組んだことだったのか……！！
Text (EN): So that means... Damn it! The whole thing was his setup from the very beginning!!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): じゃ、じゃあ私たち、騙されちゃったってこと……！？あーーっ、もう！
Text (EN): S-So we were played for fools!? Ughhh, I can't believe this!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 観光客、本当にごめんなさい！あなたのこと、サイテー野郎だなんて……酷いこと言ったわ。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】, I'm so, so sorry! Calling you a total scumbag... That was awful of me.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): す、すまなかったな……。つい、頭に血が上って……カッとなっちまって……。
Text (EN): Y-Yeah, my bad... I just saw red and lost my cool...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (EN): ... Hehe.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 一徹ストレートとマネードリームの……その気持ちは……大切に受け止める。
Text (EN): 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 and 【MONEY DREAM】... I'll treasure those feelings.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): でも、今は……観光客。今度こそ……1対1で闘ってほしい……。
Text (EN): But right now... 【{bad_name}】. This time, I want to fight you one-on-one.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: In A World For Just the Two Of Us
Text (JP): 誰にも邪魔されることのない――――2人だけの世界で。
Text (EN): With no one to interfere― in a world meant for just the two of us.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): ……負けた。
Text (EN): ...I lost.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): …………。初めてバトルしたあの夜から、ずっと……。
Text (EN): ... Ever since that first night we battled...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): どんどん速くなっていくキミに……憧れてた……。
Text (EN): Watching you get faster and faster... I've admired you...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): でも……同じやり方では、キミを超えられない……かな。
Text (EN): But... I guess I can't surpass you using the same methods.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): 私……仲間と一緒に走る。一徹ストレートやマネードリームと。
Text (EN): I'm going to race with my team... With 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 and 【MONEY DREAM】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): 一緒に走って……キミに勝てる“何か”を……探す。
Text (EN): Racing together, we'll find that something that can beat you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (JP): 次に闘う時は……その何かでキミを倒す……から。それまで……待っててほしい。
Text (EN): Next time we fight, I'll defeat you with that something... So please wait for me until then.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Person I Admire Most
Text (EN): Promise me...

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): PAで休憩を済ませ、自分のマシンの元へ戻ると、見知らぬ男が待ち構えていた。
Text (EN): After taking a break at the parking area and returning to the car, I found an unfamiliar man waiting there.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): 声をかけたが、男は不遜な態度でこちらをじろりと睨むだけで、すぐには返事を返さない。
Text (EN): Despite being addressed, the man just glared back with an arrogant attitude, not bothering to respond right away.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): 彼が身動きするたび、身に着けているアクセサリが小さな金属音を立てるのが、いやに耳につく。派手な外見でやや分かりづらいが、まだ年若い青年のようだ。
Text (EN): Every time he moved, the metallic clink of his accessories grated on the ears. His flashy appearance made it hard to tell, but he seemed to be a young man.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): …………。お前が観光客だな。<Phantom9>のメンバーから話は聞いている。
Text (EN): ... So you're 【{bad_name}】. I've heard about you from the 《Phantom9》 crew.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): そうだ――俺は2代目スネークアイズ。――新生<Phantom9>を率いる侵略者。この首都環状に君臨する新たな王者だ。
Text (EN): That's right; I'm the second 【SNAKE EYES】, the invader who leads the reborn 《Phantom9》― and the new king who reigns over the Shuto Expressway.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): 新生<Phantom9>の目的は何なのか……俺の狙う真の獲物は誰なのか……既に知っているようだな。
Text (EN): What the new 《Phantom9》 is after, and who my true prey is... You already know, don't you?

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): 俺は必ず迅帝を撃墜する……それが、あの人に――俺を吹き溜まりから拾い上げてくれた、あの人に与えてもらった使命……
Text (EN): I will take down 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 for sure... That's the mission given to me by that person― The one who pulled me out of the gutter.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): ……フン。要するに、お前は踏み台ってわけだ。
Text (EN): ...Hmph. In other words, you're just a stepping stone.

Heading: The Assassin From America
Text (JP): これまでに俺が与えた数々の試練を乗り越え、実力を蓄えてきたお前を倒し……迅帝に俺の実力を見せつけてやるよ。
Text (EN): By defeating you, who's overcome all the trials I've thrown at you and built up your skills, I'll show 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 just what I'm capable of.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): チィ……！思ったよりはやるじゃねぇか。冷めることしやがって……。
Text (EN): Tch! You're better than I thought. Way to kill my buzz...

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): アイツとの対決に備えて、セーブしていたのが間違いだったか……今日のところはこのくらいにしておいてやる。俺はこれから――――……
Text (EN): Maybe I screwed up by holding back for that showdown... I'll let you off the hook for today. I'm heading to―

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): その時、PAに1台のNSXが現れた。首都環状の夜を溶かし込んだようなディープブルーのマシン。ボディサイドに大きく描かれた文字は――――“壱撃離脱”。
Text (EN): Just then, an NSX rolled into the parking area. A machine in deep blue, as if it had absorbed the Shuto Expressway nights. Emblazoned boldly on its side was "One-Strike Retreat."

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): NSXから降りてきたのは、物静かな雰囲気の青年だった。小綺麗な出で立ちで、品の良さすら感じさせる振る舞いは、過酷なバトルの世界とは無縁のように思える。
Text (EN): A young man with a quiet presence stepped out of the NSX. His neat appearance and refined demeanor seemed utterly out of place in this brutal world of battles.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): しかし――――その眼差しの奥には、身を焦がすような情熱の炎が灯っていた。走ることに取りつかれ、スピードに魂を捧げた男――――。
Text (EN): But something burned deep in his eyes― a soul-searing flame of passion. A man possessed by racing, who'd offered his soul to speed.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): 迅帝……！
Text (EN): 【SWIFT EMPEROR】!

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): ふうん。今夜はスネークアイズと対決するつもりで来たけど、もっと面白そうな人がいるね。
Text (EN): Hmm. I came tonight planning to face 【SNAKE EYES】, but there's someone far more interesting here.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): ――――君が観光客だね？今度は、僕とバトルしてくれないか。
Text (EN): You're 【{bad_name}】, aren't you? How about a battle with me next?

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): おい！てめぇと対決するのは俺だろうが！
Text (EN): Hey! I'm the one who's supposed to face you!

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): 何を言ってるんだ？君――――負けたんだろ。
Text (EN): What are you talking about? You lost, didn't you?

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): 君とのバトルが面白そうだとは思えないな。彼だって、何度もやる意味はないと感じてるんじゃないか？
Text (EN): I don't see how battling you would be interesting. I'm sure he feels the same―there's no point in a rematch.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): なんだと……！
Text (EN): What did you say?!

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): それじゃあ……観光客。また、いずれ……。
Text (EN): Well then, 【{bad_name}】... Until we meet again.

Heading: A Man's Return
Text (JP): クソが……！俺の獲物を横取りする気か……！！
Text (EN): Damn it! You think you can just steal my prey?!

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): ……負けた……この僕が。
Text (EN): I lost. Me, of all people...

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): 新たな迅帝となった僕が……。
Text (EN): The new 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, defeated...

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): ……4年前、この首都環状のすべての走り屋を倒し――――先代から迅帝の名を継いで、頂点に立ったつもりでいた。
Text (EN): Four years ago, I crushed every Street Racer on the Shuto Expressway― I'd inherited the name 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 and thought I'd reached the top.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): もはや、ここに僕の敵などいないと……そう思っていた。
Text (EN): There were no enemies left for me here... Or so I believed.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): “何のために走るのか” ――――その答えを、僕は……。
Text (EN): "Why do I race?" For me, that answer is...

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): ありがとう。――――煌くような、楽しいバトルだったよ。
Text (EN): Thank you. That was... a radiant, thrilling battle.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): 迅帝はそう言い残すと、マシンに乗り込みPAを出て行った。
Text (EN): With those parting words, 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 got in his machine and left the parking area.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): 自分は、その姿からなぜか目が離せず――――NSXのテールランプが遠くへ走り去った後も、いつまでも見送っていた。
Text (EN): For some reason, I couldn't take my eyes off him― Even after the NSX's taillights vanished into the distance, I kept watching long after he was gone.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): ――――背後から、ぞっとするような憎悪の気配を感じる。振り向くと、幽鬼のごとき表情を浮かべたスネークアイズが無言でこちらを睨みつけていた。
Text (EN): A chilling aura of hatred crept up from behind. Turning around, 【SNAKE EYES】 stood there with a ghoulish expression, silently glaring with murderous intent.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): その仄暗い両目の奥には、血潮すら凍てついた壮絶な怒りが潜む――――。
Text (EN): Deep within those shadowy eyes lurked a rage so intense it could freeze blood.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): ……余計なことをしてくれたな。つくづく、冷めるヤローだ。
Text (EN): ...You really had to stick your nose in. You're one hell of a buzzkill.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): こんな茶番は、全て終わらせる。――――次は本気で潰してやるよ。新環状、右回りに来い。
Text (EN): I'm ending this whole charade. Next time, I'll crush you for real. New Circular Route, Right Turn. Be there.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): 俺が証明してやる……さっきの勝利はほんのまぐれだ。お前ごときが迅帝に勝てるわけがないんだからな。
Text (EN): That win was nothing but a fluke... I'll prove it to you. There's no way trash like you could beat 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Why Do You Run?
Text (JP): チッ……、イライラするぜ……！
Text (EN): Tch... This is pissing me off!

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): 馬鹿な……！俺の使命は迅帝を撃墜すること……。そのために生きてきた……。
Text (EN): Impossible! My purpose is to take down 【SWIFT EMPEROR】... That's what I've lived for...

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): お前ごときが、俺に勝てるわけがないんだ……！ましてや迅帝に……！
Text (EN): There's no way someone like you could beat me! Let alone 【SWIFT EMPEROR】!

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): ――だが！お前は、迅帝の真なる実力をまだ見ていない！
Text (EN): But―! You haven't seen 【SWIFT EMPEROR】's true power yet!

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): 迅帝が真価を発揮するのは……湾岸線だ！俺に勝った気になる前に、湾岸線で、アイツを仕留めて見せろ――。
Text (EN): 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 shows his true worth... On the Bayshore Line! Before you get cocky about beating me, go take him down there.

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): フン……！無理に決まってるだろうがな。アイツに勝てるのは俺だけだ……お前じゃない！！
Text (EN): Hmph! As if that's possible. I'm the only one who can beat him, not you!!

Heading: Just For Victory
Text (JP): 迅帝を倒せるのは……絶対に――俺だけなんだ！！
Text (EN): The only one who can defeat 【SWIFT EMPEROR】... is undeniably ME!!

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 鋼鉄のボディが繰り広げるつば迫り合い。魂と魂の削り合い。“最速” の座を争う闘いに、決着がついた――――。
Text (EN): Steel bodies locked in a Metal Body Showdown. Souls grinding against souls. The battle for the throne of speed had reached its conclusion―

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 迅帝と共にPAに戻り、マシンを降りて固く握手を交わす。
Text (EN): I returned to the parking area with 【SWIFT EMPEROR】. We stepped out of our machines and exchanged a firm handshake.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 二基のエンジンが競って生み出しつづけた熱量は、余韻となって夜空へと放散していく。燃えるように火照った手の甲を、夜の湾岸に吹く風がそっと撫でた。
Text (EN): The heat generated by two engines competing at their limits dissipated into the night sky as lingering warmth. The Bayshore night breeze gently caressed my burning knuckles.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): ――――いいバトルだった。
Text (EN): That was one hell of a battle.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 僕にやれることはすべてやった。全力を出し切った……それでもなお、届かなかった。この結果がすべてだ。
Text (EN): I gave it everything I had, pushed myself to the absolute limit... And I still couldn't reach you. The result speaks for itself.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 新たな “最速” の座は、君にこそ相応しい。――――その名前は、憶えておかないといけないな。
Text (EN): The new throne of speed belongs to you. I'll have to remember that name.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 次は必ず僕が勝つ！迅帝の名にかけて、王座を奪還して見せよう。
Text (EN): Next time, victory will be mine! On the name of 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, I swear I'll reclaim that throne.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): そうして迅帝と健闘を称え合っていると――――スネークアイズが割って入って来た。
Text (EN): As I exchanged praise of each other's performance with 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, 【SNAKE EYES】 cut in.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 冷めるなぁ……、冷めるんだよな、そういうの。
Text (EN): What a buzzkill... This kind of thing really kills the mood, you know?

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 俺のことを忘れて貰っちゃあ困るぜ。その王座とやら、今は預けておく。だが――――
Text (EN): You can't just forget about me like that. I'll let you hold onto that throne for now. But...

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 迅帝を倒し、“最速” の座につくのは――――真の王者は、この俺だ！
Text (EN): The one who'll defeat 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 and claim the throne of speed— the true king―is ME!

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): スネークアイズか……。君と彼とのバトル、見ていたよ。……あの時言ったことは訂正しよう。
Text (EN): 【SNAKE EYES】, huh... I watched your battle with him. ...I'll take back what I said before.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): あ？
Text (EN): Huh?

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): 「君とのバトルが面白そうだとは思えない」――――という言葉は撤回する。いずれ、君ともバトルがしてみたいな。
Text (EN): "I don't think a battle with you would be interesting"— I take those words back. I'd like to race you someday too.

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): チッ。……バカにしてやがるのか！？
Text (EN): Tch... You mocking me?!

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
Text (JP): そんなつもりはないのだけれど……。
Text (EN): That's not what I meant...

Heading: Four Masters of the New Generation
